analysis.environment_validation_protocol: environment-identity-gpu-validation-protocol-v1 defined=true; first-priority channel with same_environment=0.98 and reference_bank recall rules.
analysis.temporal_validation_protocol: temporal-preservation-gpu-validation-protocol-v1 defined=true; second-priority channel with same_timeline=0.95 and causal_transition_chain highest risk.
analysis.object_validation_protocol: object-identity-gpu-validation-protocol-v1 defined=true; third-priority channel with same_object=0.97 and hero_prop=0.98 role threshold.

integrated_validation_contract.scope: Integration definition only — Integrated Validation Defined != Integrated Validation Executed.
integrated_validation_contract.gpu_execution: false — integration protocol and execution sequence only; execution deferred.

cross_channel_failure_rules.environment_blocks_all: environment_identity stage failure blocks temporal_preservation and object_identity stages.
cross_channel_failure_rules.temporal_blocks_object: temporal_preservation stage failure blocks object_identity stage until exit_criteria met.
cross_channel_failure_rules.object_requires_prior_pass: object_identity entry requires environment_identity and temporal_preservation exit_criteria pass.
cross_channel_failure_rules.cross_channel_drift_cascade: environment reference_drift degrades temporal continuity_signature stability; temporal edit_rhythm_desync degrades object anchor persistence.
cross_channel_failure_rules.integrated_validation_note: Integrated Validation Defined != Integrated Validation Executed.

environment_identity.note: Batch pass rate below 0.30 aborts campaign; blocks all subsequent channels.

temporal_preservation.note: Batch pass rate below 0.35 aborts temporal stage; blocks object_identity.

object_identity.note: Batch pass rate below 0.40 aborts object stage; triggers campaign recovery audit.
